shortTitle: Depressive Symptoms and Glycemic Control in Annals of Behavioral Medicine
longTitle: Depressive Symptoms Are Not Longitudinally Associated with Joint Glycemic, Blood Pressure, and Cholesterol Control Among Middle-Aged and Older Adults with Diabetes in USA
summary: Consistent with several studies, we found that after adjusting for historical glycemic, blood pressure, and cholesterol control, depressive symptoms were not associated with future metabolic control.
citation: Varghese N.M and Varghese J.S. Depressive Symptoms Are Not Longitudinally Associated with Joint Glycemic, Blood Pressure, and Cholesterol Control Among Middle-Aged and Older Adults with Diabetes in USA. Annals of Behavioral Medicine. 2025. 59:1. doi: 10.1093/abm/kaaf015
